content.short: Sundial is the first Layer-2 to natively unlock and put trillions of dollars of Bitcoin to work through smart contracts and yield generation.
content.description: A revolutionary approach to joint BTC-ADA DeFi that will create a seamless application layer between Bitcoin's vast liquidity and Cardano's advanced smart contract capabilities. With over $500B+ in Bitcoin currently dormant and unable to participate in DeFi activities, our solution addresses a critical market gap while maintaining the highest standards of security and compliance that institutions demand, all while onboarding new users and liquidity to Cardano. Sundial prioritizes institutional-grade security with a UTXO-based architecture that eliminates common attack vectors found in account-based systems.
